image_description: A wooden display cabinet with glass doors, filled with numerous comic books arranged on shelves. The comics are stacked vertically and horizontally, showing various colorful covers with illustrated characters and titles. The lighting creates reflections on the glass doors.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Staple-bound periodical magazine with portrait-oriented rectangular proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple comic books are visible in standard portrait rectangular format typical of periodicals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Covers show vibrant colors, illustrations, and visible title text (e.g., 'Daredevil', 'Spider-Man').
The resolution and angle do not allow for clear visualization of staple binding marks on the spines; most spines are obscured or too distant.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Substantial page count with sequential panel layouts.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The comics are closed; interior pages and panel layouts are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hand-drawn or digitally rendered illustrations with speech bubbles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Speech bubbles are interior elements and cannot be seen on the closed covers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caption boxes and dialogue text within panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Interior text and panels are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly glossy paper stock with vibrant CMYK color printing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The covers exhibit a sheen consistent with glossy paper, and colors are vibrant.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cover art exhibits dynamic character poses and action compositions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible covers feature superhero characters in active, dynamic poses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Periodical format for serialized graphic storytelling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The collection clearly represents serialized comic book issues.

artifact_observations.location: Comic book titles and logos on various covers
artifact_observations.reasoning: Several titles and logos appear distorted or illegible upon close inspection (e.g., top right yellow logo, some spine text). While stylized, some letterforms lack coherent structure typical of AI generation.
Reflections on the glass doors are somewhat inconsistent with the internal lighting sources. Wood grain on the cabinet frame appears slightly smudged or painterly in areas.
The stack of black/spine-out comics appears to merge slightly at the edges, lacking distinct separation between individual issues.

selected_experts.reason: To verify that the objects are indeed recognized as comic books/magazines and not just generic rectangles with noise.
To rigorously audit the legibility and coherence of the text on the covers, which is a primary failure mode in AI-generated images containing text.
To check for fusion or bleeding between adjacent comic books in the stacks, ensuring they are distinct physical objects.
To assess global coherence, lighting consistency, and any subtle generative artifacts in the background/cabinet.

focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of text on comic covers
Distinct boundaries between stacked comic books
Consistency of reflections on glass surfaces
Recognition of specific comic book branding/art style
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is largely gibberish, this is a significant artifact for a 'comic book' class which relies heavily on typography. Also, verify if the 'fusion' in the stacks is real or just low-resolution compression.
